\par\vspace{2pt}\footnotesize\textit{Preliminary observations (to verify):}
\begin{itemize}\setlength{\itemsep}{0pt}\setlength{\parskip}{0pt}
  \item \textbf{Same pattern as papers100M, smaller graph.} A hybrid beats baseline gsplit in 18 of 20 cells; the DP hybrid is the fastest in 15 of them and its gain again grows with $k$, peaking on \textbf{PCIe + deep/wide} (SAGE PCIe $L{=}3,h{=}4096$: $+39\%$; $L{=}4$: $+33\%$).
  \item \textbf{The two non-wins are small GAT on NVLink} ($L{=}2$ and $L{=}4,h{=}1024$), where the cheap NVLink all-to-all leaves little shuffle for a hybrid to recover and baseline split is already near-best --- consistent with the interconnect argument of \S\ref{sec:hybrid-tradeoff}.
  \item \textbf{GAT pipeline OOMs only on the larger configs} (12 of 30 cells: $h{=}4096$ and the deeper/shallower $h{=}1024$), not all of them as on papers100M --- products' smaller footprint lets the pipeline's two live micro-batches fit for the smaller GAT cells. (Preliminary; to verify.)
\end{itemize}
